function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT pl.vendor_id,
       pl.sku,
       pl.period,
       pl.unit_price_orig,
       pl.contract_unit_price,
       pl.qty,
       pl.fx_rate,
       (pl.unit_price_orig - pl.contract_unit_price) * pl.qty * pl.fx_rate AS excess_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
WHERE pl.vendor_id = 'VEND-SNC'
  AND pl.period = '2026-08'
  AND pl.unit_price_orig > pl.contract_unit_price
ORDER BY pl.sku","purpose":"Check purchase lines where unit_price_orig > contract_unit_price for vendor VEND-SNC in August 2026"}
